# Verify golden

Byte-identical copy of `go-pflow/verify/testdata/showcase/properties.json`,
generated by go-pflow's `cmd/properties-goldens` against the pflow-xyz
showcase's own `cafe-order.json` ("Variation III"). The model is read as a
`metamodel.Model` and bridged to an analysable `petri.PetriNet` through
`metamodel/metapetri` — go-pflow's own documented path for "analyse a
Model" — so the golden's `conversion_diagnostics` records what that bridge
had to approximate, not just the property verdicts.

The representative property set — `bounded`, `deadlock-free`, `live`,
`terminating`, `conserves`, the model's own declared `one_state` invariant,
a mutual-exclusion over the order's seven states, two `reachable` targets
and one `unreachable` target — is the same shorthand vocabulary
`petri_verify`/`pflow verify` expose, run directly against `verify.Property`
so the golden pins the library's output, not the CLI/MCP JSON-shorthand
parsing layered on top of it.

`tests/showcase_properties.rs` builds the identical property list from the
golden's own `properties` array (so the two sides can never silently drift
out of the order the golden's `report.verdicts` line up against), runs
`pflow_verify::Verifier::check`, and asserts `==` field for field against
each golden verdict: `status`, `method`, `detail`, `evidence`, and — where
present — `counterexample.{trace,marking,explanation}`, plus the report's
aggregate `proved`/`refuted`/`unknown`/`ok`/`state_count`/`truncated` and
`summary()`. This closes `pflow-rs/ROADMAP.md` Phase 2's exit criterion
("`petri_verify`-equivalent output for `cafe-order.json` matches Go field
for field") with an actual go-pflow-produced golden, rather than the
sibling-repo integration check `tests/cafe_order.rs` already held it to
(no Go reference output existed to copy until this golden did).

One real mismatch this golden caught and fixed: `pflow-verify`'s
`format_trace`/cycle-join helpers joined a firing sequence with an ASCII
`" -> "`; go-pflow's `formatTrace` (`verify/verify.go`) joins with the
Unicode arrow `" → "` (U+2192). Evidence strings like `"firing sequence: pay
→ start_brew → finish_brew → pick_up"` are part of the byte-exact contract
this golden pins, so the separator was fixed to match rather than the
assertion loosened to `contains`.

Skips quietly without a `pflow-xyz` checkout as a sibling of this repo (the
source `cafe-order.json` lives there), the same as `tests/cafe_order.rs`.

The sha256 is pinned in `go-pflow.lock` at the repo root, verified offline
with `./scripts/go-pflow-goldens.sh check`. The generating commit (recorded
in `go-pflow.lock`) is `d84dc017bfe42acd03176b74a7bb91878d72d5f1-dirty`:
`cmd/properties-goldens` itself was a new, uncommitted file in the go-pflow
working tree when this golden was generated; the commit it was generated
*against* is the one the rest of `go-pflow.lock` already pins.
